text:
maria: seeing a spike in reconnects this morning right after auth handoffs in eu-west, ~30% higher than baseline. clients report stalled SSE streams then immediate reconnect loop :confused:
kevin: got any steps to reproduce? is this specific to resume-token flow or all auth rotations?
maria: seems tied to resume-token exchange. repro: client connects -> server returns 401 while rotating token -> client reauths -> reconnect burst. logs show auth_handoff_latency_ms jumping to 1.2s and then sse_reconnect_rate spikes. snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="redwood", error="invalid_token"

// client backoff: 100ms -> 200ms -> 400ms (but many clients configured fast retry)
```
raj: that latency number is worrisome. where is the delay happening — auth service, proxy, or resume validation? can we correlate traces?
sara: I'm seeing traces with long wait between proxy and auth-svc: proxy waits for auth token fetch from keyring, then retries auth endpoint. suspect keyring mutex contention during rotation.
maria: attaching quick grep from proxy logs (trimmed):
```
[proxy] 10:12:34 GET /stream tenant=acme resume_id=abc123 -> 401
[proxy] 10:12:34 fetching token from keyring (rotating)
[proxy] 10:12:35 auth-svc validate resume_id=abc123 -> 200
[proxy] 10:12:35 proxy accepts connection -> emit SSE
[client] 10:12:35 stream starts but client sees EOF and reconnects
```
kevin: so proxy delays ~1s while keyring rotates. that aligns with auth_handoff_latency_ms. high fanout tenants will amplify reconnects.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-145 streaming auth-handoff surge (assigned: kevin)
kevin: short-term mitigations: 1) increase client jitter/backoff recommended in SDK (add randomized 400-800ms) 2) make proxy return `Retry-After` header on 401 during rotation so clients don't hammer 3) disable synchronous keyring refresh on hot path (if safe)
raj: for 2) we can change proxy to return 503 with `Retry-After` for rotation windows. but that affects billing telemetry since reauths are treated as normal reconnects — might inflate sse_reconnect_billing_delta. need product input.
sara: longer-term: move keyring refresh to background & provide a hot standby token cache, and expose a metric `keyring_refresh_block_ms` to console so ops can correlate.
maria: +1. also our console alerts only track sse_reconnect_rate per region, but not auth_handoff_latency dimension. we should add a per-tenant `auth_handoff_latency_ms` heatmap to streaming dashboard. current dashboard query: 
```
sum(rate(sse_reconnect_total[5m])) by (region)
```
we could augment: 
```
sum(rate(sse_reconnect_total[5m])) by (region, tenant),
avg(auth_handoff_latency_ms) by (region, tenant)
```
kevin: agreed. small UX ask: when there is a rollout touching auth/keyring, console should flag rollout->streaming correlated spikes automatically. can we add an annotation pipeline that links deploy tags to metric spikes?
sara: we have deploy events in tracing; can annotate metrics during a canary window. implementation: pipeline that listens to deploy webhook, then scans `auth_handoff_latency_ms` for 10m after deployment and surfaces an alert card if > 95th percentile threshold.
raj: coding wise I can stub the metric exporter and add `keyring_refresh_block_ms` in next patch. but before that, can we hotfix to return `Retry-After` 10s on 401 when rotation-in-progress flag is set? it's low-risk.
maria: can we also patch SDKs to implement jittered reconnection on 401 specifically? mention in release notes.
kevin: plan: (1) rollback any recent keyring deploys (if any) — checking deploy audit, (2) hotfix proxy to return 503+Retry-After during rotation, (3) SDK doc update + quick client-side throttle in CDN edge lambda, (4) add dashboard heatmap and metric exporter in next sprint.
sara: I'll open PR for proxy change (w/ feature flag) and add metric instrumentation. assigning to @raj for exporter.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: proxy-hotfix-canary -> 10:30 UTC (canary: 5% eu-west)
kevin: thanks. leaving a note: watch sse_reconnect_rate, auth_handoff_latency_ms, keyring_refresh_block_ms, and console alerts for billing_delta. if we see reconnect billing spike, have finance on standby.
maria: thanks team — will update this thread with post-canary numbers. :thumbsup:
kevin: one more: add a transient state in resume-token validation so we don't issue duplicate billable sessions for retries (dedupe window). else customers get charged twice during this churn.
raj: noted. I'll design a 3s dedupe window keyed by resume_id + client_ip. low-memory cost.
sara: added to backlog and will try to slot in after metric exporter.
maria: ping me when canary done and post graphs.
kevin: will do.
